title: genes: form parameters of the plant generator, plant@1
description: The `form` of a plant look whose generator is plant@1 (spec §6.1, §7.2). Every parameter has a default, so a look writes only what makes its species different. A 'range' is a number or [min, max]: each variant draws its own value (an individual's trait, the same in all its stages), and per-branch values are drawn again for every branch. Lengths in metres unless the name says otherwise; fractions 0–1. docs/HOW_TO_ADD_A_SPECIES.md explains how to read a photo into these numbers.

count.description: Leaders above the fork. 1 = one main axis that runs to the top (a pine, a young tree); 2–4 = the trunk splits into that many limbs (algarrobo, most open-grown broadleaves).

split_height.description: Height of the fork as a fraction of the tree's height. Low (0.1–0.3) = short trunk forked low; 0 = several stems from the ground. With count 1 it is where the main axis starts carrying the crown.

fork_angle_deg.description: Angle of each leader from the trunk's axis at the fork. Wide (40–60) gives a spreading, umbrella crown; narrow (10–25) a vase or an upright crown.

leader_reach.description: How far each leader runs towards the crown's edge, as a fraction of the distance to it.

leader_curve.description: Bend of the leaders along their length: positive turns them up (upright crowns), negative arches them outwards and down (algarrobo, spreading trees).

lean_deg.description: Lean of the whole trunk from vertical. Each variant leans its own way.

twist.description: How much the trunk and the leaders wander and twist instead of running straight.

tortuosity.description: Big slow S-bends of the trunk and the leaders (and, at 60 %, of the level-1 limbs), snaking in three dimensions: 0 = straight, 0.5 = clearly crooked, 1 = a contorted old algarrobo. Not the small zig-zag of twist.

bends.description: How many bends along the trunk and each leader (waves along its length): 1 = one long S, 3 = a restless trunk.

bend_style.description: smooth = slow S-curves that turn in space (algarrobo); elbows = straight runs broken by sharp kinks (tala, espinillo).

fluting.description: Ribs and grooves running up the trunk and the leaders in a slow spiral, as if several stems had fused (old algarrobos, quebrachos). 0 = round.

gnarl.description: Bumps, lobes and buttresses on the trunk's surface.

radius_per_height.description: Trunk radius at 1.3 m divided by the tree's height. From the sheet: (trunk_dbh_m / 2) / adult_height_m.

taper.description: How fast the trunk and every branch thin towards the tip.

flare.description: Extra width at the foot of the trunk.

tile_m.description: Real size of one repeat of the bark texture.

branching.description: One entry per branching level below the leaders, from the thickest (1) to the twigs (3 at most). Each level grows on the one before.

count.description: Branches on a parent of typical length for its level (longer parents carry more).

start.description: Part of the parent where branches grow, as fractions of its length from its base.

angle_deg.description: Angle from the parent at the base of the branch.

length.description: Length relative to the parent. Branches near the parent's tip are shorter; all are cut at the crown's envelope.

curve.description: Bend over the branch: positive turns up, negative turns away from up.

droop.description: Sag under its own weight, strongest at the tip.

tortuosity.description: Big bends of the branches of this level, like trunk.tortuosity. Default: 60 % of the trunk's for level 1, none for the others.

bend_style.description: Default: the trunk's bend_style. Old algarrobos: smooth limbs, elbowed branches.

radius_ratio.description: Base radius relative to the parent's radius where it grows.

roll.description: How branches turn around the parent.

envelope.description: Shape the branches are pruned to.

width_to_height.description: Crown width divided by tree height. From the sheet: crown_width_m / adult_height_m. Above 1 = wider than tall.

base.description: Height where the crown starts, as a fraction of the tree's height.

widest.description: Where the crown is widest, as a fraction of its depth from its base. Default from the envelope: umbrella 0.7, globose 0.5, conical 0.05, columnar 0.5, weeping 0.6, irregular 0.5.

flat_top.description: 0 = rounded top; 1 = cut flat, the crown keeps its width up to the top.

irregular.description: Lobes and gaps around the crown's outline.

openness.description: How much sky shows through the crown: 0 = a dense ball, 0.6 = airy, branches visible.

clump_size_m.description: Size of one painted foliage clump on an adult. Smaller stages scale it down.

balance.description: How evenly the main limbs spread round the trunk: 0 = wherever they grow (lopsided crowns happen), 1 = the same amount of limb on every side, low sagging limbs too.

fill_top.description: How fully the top of the crown is covered: where no foliage reaches the crown's upper surface, a thin crooked branch rises from the nearest limb with leaves at its tips. 0 = leave gaps; 1 = every gap filled. Trees always have leaves on top, so keep it high.

clump_spacing.description: Distance between clumps along a twig, in clump sizes.

leaf_type.description: Sets the painted clump texture: bipinnate is feathery and airy, broad is a dense mass.

leaf_size_cm.description: Real leaf length; the texture's marks scale with it.

cards_per_clump.description: Crossed cards in one clump (two triangles each).

density.description: How full each clump's texture is: 0 = a few sprays you see through, 1 = a solid mass. Airy trees (algarrobo, espinillo) 0.2–0.3.

twigs.description: Dark crooked twigs painted inside each clump, under the leaves: the fine branch net that shows through airy foliage. 0 = none, 1 = a dense net (old algarrobos).

leafy_from.description: Clumps sit on twigs from this fraction of their length to the tip.

spacing_m.description: Distance between thorn nodes along a branch.

length_cm.description: Real length of one flower or inflorescence.

cover.description: Share of the clumps that carry flowers at peak.

show_scale.description: Painted exaggeration: the real size times this, so the part still reads from a few metres away (a recognisable trait). 1 = real size.

width_cm.description: Pods and samaras: width; round fruit: ignored (length is the diameter).

hanging.description: Pods and bunches hang down from the twig.

cover.description: Share of the clumps that carry fruit at peak.

show_scale.description: Painted exaggeration: the real size times this, so the part still reads from a few metres away (a recognisable trait). 1 = real size.

broken_limbs.description: Main limbs broken off, leaving a stub.

trunk_split.description: How far an old tree's trunk has opened: 0 = one whole trunk, 1 = it splits from near the ground into stems that rise side by side with a crack between them, then part (old algarrobos). Also dead and fallen trees.

limb_sag.description: How far down the sagging low limbs of an old (or dead standing) tree reach: 0 = they stay up in the crown, 0.5 = they arch out and sag halfway to the ground, 1 = they reach the ground, lie along it and rise again (old algarrobos).

sagging_limbs.description: Share of the low main limbs that sag as limb_sag says.

crown_thinning.description: Share of the clumps an old tree has lost.

lost_twigs.description: Share of the thinnest branches gone from a dead tree.

broken_top.description: Leaders of a dead tree keep this fraction of their length.

stages.description: Changes for one stage, written like the form itself (only what changes; a `branching` list replaces the whole list), plus `levels`: how many branching levels the stage grows. Defaults: seedling 0 levels, sapling 1, young 2, no flowers or fruit before young.
